dimensions.assessment: Affects the Department of State and congressional committees receiving periodic reports.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary of State shall... not less than every five years, conduct a review of the Department of State's guidance that governs relations with Taiwan

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a recurring reporting and review requirement for diplomatic guidance.
dimensions.evidence: submit an updated report to the Committee on Foreign Relations of the Senate and the Committee on Foreign Affairs of the House of Representatives

dimensions.assessment: No federal appropriations or fiscal expenditures are specified in the text.
Amends existing statutory reporting requirements for foreign relations guidance regarding Taiwan.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the Taiwan Assurance Act of 2020 to require periodic reviews and updated reports relating to the Department of State's Taiwan Guidelines

dimensions.assessment: Permanent ongoing requirement for reviews and reports as long as the guidance is maintained.
dimensions.evidence: For as long as the Department of State maintains guidance that governs relations with Taiwan... not less than every five years, conduct a review

missing_information: Administrative costs associated with preparing periodic reviews.
importance_detail.rationale: Amends the Taiwan Assurance Act of 2020 to require the Department of State to review and report on its guidance governing relations with Taiwan every five years.
